title: Oozy Dutch Vine Tomatoes Stew
description: A comforting and citrusy Dutch stew featuring vine tomatoes and yuzu-cure, perfect for a sick day, served in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the vine tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the tomatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic in olive oil over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the roasted tomatoes, yuzu juice, and agave syrup to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the stew for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, in an agave leaf vessel.
